hooks.command: p=$(jq -r '.worktree_path // empty'); log="$HOME/.claude/worktree-setup.log"; if [ -n "$p" ] && cd "$p" && pnpm install >"$log" 2>&1 && pnpm generate >>"$log" 2>&1; then echo '{"systemMessage":"worktree setup: pnpm install / pnpm generate 完了"}'; else echo '{"systemMessage":"worktree setup 失敗: ~/.claude/worktree-setup.log を確認し、worktree 内で pnpm install / pnpm generate を手動実行してください"}'; fi
hooks.statusMessage: worktree セットアップ中 (pnpm install / pnpm generate)...
